_comment: BEFORE-AFTER-SPLIT on two 10 s Kling 3.0 takes of the same dolly: start frame by Kling text_to_image (renovated), the dated version by image_to_image with the same camera, then image_to_video on both with one identical camera prompt (plates: G_studio/kling_plates/ba_before.mp4 + ba_after.mp4).
